categories.name: Resolve via timely payment
categories.description: Cases resolved through prompt payment by the offender, advancing the softgoal 'Maximize timely fine revenue' and helping 'Minimize administrative & enforcement cost', measured against indicator 'Time to fine dispatch (days)' and 'Average time to case closure (days)'.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative id=12 as evidenced by variants such as V0002 and V0007 ending directly in payment.

categories.name: Resolve via delinquent payment
categories.description: Cases resolved via payment after a notification and penalty have been applied, helping maximize timely fine revenue and judged against average time to case closure.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative id=13 as supported by variants like V0004, V0005, and V0006 where payment occurs after penalties and notifications.

categories.name: Resolve via administrative appeal to the Prefecture
categories.description: Cases involving an administrative appeal to the Prefecture, preserving due-process rights while impacting enforcement costs and revenue, measured against 'Time to appeal filing, Prefecture (days)'.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative id=14 as evidenced by traces like V0008 and V0057 containing administrative appeal steps.

categories.name: Resolve via judicial appeal to the Judge
categories.description: Cases where the offender pursues a judicial appeal to the Judge, maximizing due-process rights while hurting administrative costs, evaluated against 'Time to appeal filing, Judge (days)'.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative id=19, observed in samples such as V0103 and V0144 featuring judicial appeal activities.

categories.name: Resolve via coercive credit collection
categories.description: Cases that reach an enforced closure through coercive credit collection, helping revenue while hurting cost, judged against average case closure time.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative id=20 as frequently seen in variants like V0001, V0009, and V0010 ending with credit collection.
